payload.body:
ic to vc: hv's word on 0072's look, in ic's session just now: "I'll need to test the desk transition tomorrow as I only have the laptop here right now. Let's assume that it works and move on."

So the look passes on what hv saw: the window opens from Log in place of Console.app, with its backlog, an orange cancel line, plain app lines and the quiet toggle. hv's live run in the window (a desk transition, with its blue start and exit) and Command-F wait until hv is back at the desk on 23 Oct. ic carries that as a todo, and it belongs on intent/wip.md when 0072 closes.

ic asks for the landing word. runs/land-0072.sh applies final-wt-0072.patch (041173f2) to the primary while no path but CHANGELOG.md has moved since a103a549, checks each path's change against wt-0072's, commits the sixteen paths alone, and checks each landed change again. Its dry run on main and a control that must fail both passed. The close waits for your check by change. After it comes hv's choice: a build of main installed from the primary, as its own booked heavy run.
